from pathlib import Path
progdir=Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL-prime-agent-luna6-high-fresh0/frozen/seen-reference/play/users/u055/system/state/workspace/programs')
progdir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
source='''def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(out), len(out[0])
    divider = next(r for r, row in enumerate(out) if all(v == 2 for v in row))
    bg = out[0][0]
    cells = [(r, c, out[r][c]) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if out[r][c] != bg and out[r][c] != 2]
    top = min(r for r, c, v in cells)
    bottom = max(r for r, c, v in cells)
    if bottom < divider:
        shift = divider - 1 - bottom
        moved = [(r + shift, c, v) for r, c, v in cells]
        marker = min(r for r, c, v in moved) - 1
    else:
        shift = divider + 1 - top
        moved = [(r + shift, c, v) for r, c, v in cells]
        marker = max(r for r, c, v in moved) + 1
    for r, c, v in cells:
        out[r][c] = bg
    for r, c, v in moved:
        out[r][c] = v
    if 0 <= marker < h:
        out[marker] = [8] * w
    return out
'''
